contexts.text: All iniquity is blood; for the fountain of all iniquities is hatred. AC 379.
Cain said... Mine iniquity is greater than can be taken away = the consequent despair.
Iniquity and violence are predicated of the things of the will, or of works.
Lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city () = lest they should perish in the evils of falsity. Iniquity = evil.
On account of the multiplication of iniquity () = according to the falsities of faith.
God hath found the iniquity of thy servants () = confession that they had done iniquitously...
Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons = the prolification of falsity from evil...

Evils are sometimes called sins; sometimes iniquities... Those are called iniquities which are done against the goods of faith; sins, those which are done against the goods of charity and love. Illustrated.
Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the saints () = the removal of falsities and evils with those who are in good from the Lord. AC 9965.
(The bearing of iniquities. Explained.) AC 9937:5.
That to bear iniquity = to expiate, thus to remove sins. Illustrated.
To bear iniquity, when they did not do according to the statutes, = damnation because sins were not removed... Illustrated.
Bearing iniquity, transgression, and sin () = the removal of evil and its falsity so that it does not appear.
Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons, and upon the sons sons () = the rejection and damnation of evils and the derivative falsities in a long series.
Be Thou propitious to our iniquity, and to our sin () = that their interiors which abound in falsities and evils may be removed.
Hence it is evident that to bear iniquities = to represent in one's self sins against the Divine truths of the Word.
The term iniquity is predicated of falsity. (As sin is of evil.)
Without the Redemption... iniquity and wickedness would have overrun...
That the good which is charity and the evil which is iniquity are imputed after death...
The iniquity once inrooted... is handed down to posterity...
The iniquity of Ephraim () = the falsities of the understanding; the evils of Samaria = the evils of the will.
Evils are signified by the iniquity which his heart does ().
Iniquity is said of the life of falsity, or of life against truths; and sin of a life of evil...
To wash from iniquity () = from falsities; and from sin = from evils; for iniquity is said of falsities; and sin of evils.
The evils of doctrine, religion, and worship, are signified by, All are iniquity... ().

This is meant by... I know you not, workers of iniquity. It seems as if they had not worked iniquity, seeing that they had done such things. But still all that is iniquity which a man does solely for the sake of self and the world...
The falsities of evil are signified by the multitude of iniquity ().
The falsity of a perverted understanding is signified by the iniquity of Ephraim (); and the evil of falsity, by his sin.
Occurs. AE 778:11.
Iniquity is said of falsities.
A people heavy with iniquity () = those who are in the derivative falsities.
Meritorious goods are in themselves iniquitous. AE 794:3.
Iniquity has relation to evil; and deceit to the derivative falsity. Illustrated.
Those who do iniquity () = those who live evilly.
Lest they bear their iniquity and die () = that otherwise falsities from Hell would destroy them.
Her iniquity is expiated () = that thus evil has been removed by the Lord.
